text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have won, but during the race,
her
pacing seemed off. Anxious about
her condition, I
run out onto the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I did it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, I must apologize. I feel a bit
off today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes. I never found myself rushing like
this
before. I wonder why...
choice_data_list: You were running a bit overeager, ...
You were running a bit overeager, ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to think that someone as
easygoing as
Mejiro Bright would find
herself panicking during
a race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This was such an important race... But, I
still
managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spring has arrived, and not just to the
base of
Mount Yotei, but here as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Grandmother, it's Bright! She won!

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It comes as no surprise.
It is as I said
after
her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
I declared that she would be the next

Umamusume to win the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But that race was like watching
turtles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bright. I am proud to
have you
as my successor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our bond has grown quite deep, yes?
It's hard to
think we were once so alien
to each other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You're right, McQueen... I will do my
best to
fulfill my duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I hope I can run
side-by-side with
you in another spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... This feels kinda bittersweet. You
used to
be like a mini-me, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My feelings toward you haven't changed
one bit,
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: To have all of you around me, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Here Mejiro Bright stands, at the heart
of the
incredible Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, have you decided on
the next
race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's a good point. What would be best
to prove
that Bright can stand up to
these
speed-generation racers?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a specific race in mind, but
there is
one unchanging wish I've held
onto for a long
time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in races that are meaningful
to the
Mejiros. I have to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, a race that's important to the Mejiros
but also
relies heavily on speed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One race comes to mind. It meets both
criteria
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho... I cannot say I'm

surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's exactly what I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's already won the spring Tenno Sho,
so of
course the allure of winning the
Twin Tenno Sho
would speak to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, other Umamusume are bound to
want an opportunity to measure the new
generation's speed. It's the perfect stage
for a Mejiro to show
her stuff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided, let's start
preparing for the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but before that... Trainer, there's
something I
need to discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Everyone's been going on about speed this and speed that, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Who would you regard as the fastest Umamusume right now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lots of contenders come to mind.
However, there is one Umamusume who
rose to unexpected fame
with her almost
supernatural speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright knows her well, but she has
since
transformed into a most fearsome
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I won't turn back anymore. I will never
look back
again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
From the second those gates open until I
cross the finish line, no one will catch
even a glimpse of
that view from the
lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
A decisive victory for Silence Suzuka!
What an
unbelievable margin to win by
in this G2 race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
That's her fourth victory in a row! And
with her otherworldly domination as a
front runner, she's
on her way to the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Suzuka... How did I not predict this?

text_block_list.name: The Mejiros
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wow, Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watching the race from the
Mejiro
estate seems to freeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka, who competed with
Mejiro Bright during the Classics, is the
Umamusume being
lauded as this
generation's fastest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, I... I'm going to run in the
Takarazuka
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be permissible for you to shoulder this burden all by yourself. Plus, we promised that we'd both work hard for the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if you'll change your plans,
but I'm
going to race. Even if I lose, we'll
learn something
about her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course, my first aim is to win! I'm a
Mejiro
Umamusume too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober... Your passion is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if possible, I would also like to
race with
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our ultimate goal might be the autumn
Tenno Sho, but the Takarazuka Kinen is
also an important race. We could use it
to test the
waters.
